Set up an AFNI first-level GLM

Source: R/afni_l1_model.R
afni_l1_model.Rd

Runs within a subject/session share task coefficients and have independent polynomial baselines and nuisance coefficients. The pipeline's convolved design is passed to 3dDeconvolve; 3dREMLfit is the default estimator.

Usage

afni_l1_model(
  id,
  session,
  l1_confound_files = NULL,
  d_obj,
  gpa,
  model_name,
  run_nifti = NULL,
  censor_files = NULL
)

Arguments

id, session

Subject and session identifiers.

l1_confound_files

Optional nuisance files, one per BDM run.

d_obj

A build_design_matrix (bdm) object.

gpa

A glm_pipeline_arguments object.

model_name

Name of the L1 model.

run_nifti

Optional input images when absent from d_obj.

censor_files

Optional binary AFNI censor files, one per BDM run.

Value

A one-row AFNI setup/status data.frame.
